s: Are you ready to play today?
Do you want to play football with me?
Do you run in the morning too?
No, I run in the evening.
We run in the park near my home.
I like to run with friends.
Let us play with our team today.
Our team is at the park.
A team is a group of friends who play together.
Yes, our team can win today.
To win, we must score a goal.
To score a goal, kick the ball into the goal.
The goal is big and white.
I will kick the ball hard.
I hope I score a goal for our team.
Last week I helped my team score two goals.
Our coach teaches us to play well every day.
Our coach says run fast and jump high.
Do you like to jump, Maya?
Can you jump higher than me?
I try to jump high, but you jump higher.
After football, I like to swim.
Swim is good for the body.
Do you swim in the pool near your home?
Yes, I swim in the pool every week.
We swim and we play in the water.
Our coach says swim is good exercise.
Sport makes us strong and happy.
Our coach always says drink water.
He was a good player before.
Now he helps our team win.
I want to be like our coach one day.
First, I must run fast, jump high, and score goals.
You play with the ball every day.
A good team needs good friends.
We run together, we jump together, we play together, we win together.
We run together and we win together.
Let us go to the park now.
Let us run to the park.
Our team is waiting for us.
Score one goal, then score two goals.
Our team will win the game.
Our coach will be happy if we win.
Let us play our best game today.
